name: Hip Abductor Muscle Strain
definition: Acute strain of gluteus medius/minimus or related hip-abductor musculature following sudden loading or stretch.

typical: Lateral hip pain after acute activity

investigations.principle: Usually clinical; MRI/ultrasound is used for severe injury or suspected tear.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, cartilage, tendon, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

amber: Persistent weakness warrants imaging for tendon tear.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Shroni/Mamsa injury phenotype may be documented.

patientEducation.summary: Acute strain of gluteus medius/minimus or related hip-abductor musculature following sudden loading or stretch.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, major trauma, severe deformity, progressive weakness, suspected tendon rupture, infection or other listed red flags.
